ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white regions separated by a central vertical black column at the notch. Left lobe contains a single thin dark diagonal line. Right lobe features a prominent vertical black band near the tip and a small dark focal spot near the trailing edge center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, symmetrical U-shaped depression with a depth of approximately 4-6% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Increased frequency of jagged pixel-peaks visible on the outer third of both fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted from the central notch to the rounded distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) extending diagonally across the high-intensity region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small indentations and nicks along the trailing edge boundary; a prominent vertical black band on the right lobe that may represent a significant pigment feature or healed trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique vertical black pinstripe or band crossing the white field of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.
